_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide 3rd Grade - Open Up Resources with Open Up (OUR Math), uploaded 8/30/26, transcribed by week. Same segment-list schema as Grades K/1/2's our_math_g{K,1,2}_weeks.json.
_note: Module = Unit (OUR Math's own numbering), Unit = Section (hyphenated when a week's lessons span multiple sections within the same Unit, e.g. 'B-C'). Course finishes at week 35 (Unit 8 Assessment); week 36 is generic 'Roll and Add'/'Math Achievement Showcase' review activities with no Unit/Section/Lesson content, so it carries no key here - same shape as Grades 1 and 2's course ending one week early. Confirmed against Appendix A's Grade 3 OUR Math bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md: all 10 LPs match line-for-line (lesson lists, checkpoint placement, and header text including the shared typos below), except that Appendix A collapses each guide week into one bullet while this file keeps the guide's own two-part weeks as two segments - expected, not a defect. Guide typo, same family as Grades 1 and 2's: the header table for weeks 29 and 30 misplaces a lesson relative to its own body - week 29's header claims 'Section B Lessons 6-9 & Section C Lesson 10' but the week's own body has no Lesson 10, and week 30's header claims 'Section C Lessons 11-12 & Section D Lessons 13-15' but the body's own lesson-by-lesson list runs Lesson 10 (Section C) through Lesson 12, then Lessons 13-14 (Section D) only - Lesson 15 falls in week 31's body instead. Resolved in favor of the week's own lesson-by-lesson content in both cases, confirmed against Appendix A, which independently reproduces the same header text next to a title list that matches the body, not the header (Appendix A's week-29 bullet lists only L6-L9's titles despite its header saying 'Section C Lesson 10'; its week-30 bullet lists L10-L14's titles despite its header saying Section C starts at 11). Lesson accounting is clean regardless: Unit 7 is contiguous 1-15 across weeks 28-31 either way. A second, distinct pattern (not a typo, not previously seen in Grades K/1/2): at two Unit/Section boundaries the guide's own Checkpoint link is printed in the FOLLOWING week's table, detached from the lessons it assesses, rather than at the end of the week those lessons appear in - week 13 opens with 'Section C Checkpoint' though Section C's own lessons (13-16) were all in week 12's table, week 14 opens with 'Section D Checkpoint' (plus Unit 3 Review/Assessment) though Section D's lessons (17-21) were all in week 13's table, and week 25 opens with 'Section A Checkpoint' though Section A's lessons (1-5) were all in week 24's table. Each is transcribed as its own assessment-only segment (no lessons key) in the week the guide's table actually prints it, per the standing rule of transcribing the guide's own week boundaries rather than moving content to make weeks 'look right.' Appendix A shows the same displacement and, having no per-week segment structure of its own, simply folds the trailing checkpoint into the same bullet as the following section's lessons (e.g. week 25's bullet lists both 'Section A Checkpoint' and 'Section B Checkpoint' together) - that is Appendix A's own compression, not evidence the checkpoint belongs with those lessons. Unit 8 is the only unit in this guide with no Section Checkpoints printed at all (weeks 32-35 name lessons only, ending in a plain 'Unit 8 Assessment' with no preceding Section D Checkpoint) - confirmed against Appendix A, which also carries no Section Checkpoint for Unit 8. Lesson accounting is contiguous from 1 within each of Units 1-8 (21, 15, 21, 22, 18, 16, 15, 15 lessons respectively), with no gaps or duplicates, confirmed independently of the checkpoint-placement questions above.
